desc.zh: 从完整状态的分层搜索，推导乐观下界并用 A* 减少探索。
desc.en: Derive an optimistic bound from full-state BFS and prioritize exploration with A*.

complexity: O(D * 2^D) time; O(2^D) space, conservative unit-cost bounds for optimal command depth D; heap work O(Q log Q) for Q generated entries

concepts.name: Race Car state-space BFS
concepts.description: Full position and signed speed pairs preserve future actions; unit-cost layers prove shortest arrival.
